title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Dat (Sony D8) -> CD (Tascam CDRW700) -> Samplitude Professional v7.02 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of a perfect 9/21/82 show with a unique setlist and a sweet Touch > Samson sequence.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the pristine, high‑end‑emphasized soundboard recording, calling it a clean copy that sounds almost “dolby‑ee.” The performance is described as flawless – especially the unusual first‑set choices and the standout Touch > Samson segue – making this one of the most beloved 1982 shows.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are positive (average 4.25 stars), praising both sound quality and musical performance; the show is highlighted as perfect, warranting a rating in the high‑4 range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note a clean copy with crisp clarity, high‑end emphasis and no reported dropouts or muddiness – essentially an excellent soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unique first‑set song choices are praised; the set flows smoothly with a particularly sweet Touch > Samson transition.
